quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes signed inner/outer edge blur with text and stroke controls, saved palette sets, grouped-row individual editing, YouTube thumbnail import, Google Fonts options, vertical text writing, CSV/HTML persistence, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README and user guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: edge blur direction and text support, palette-level color management and application GUI, grouped object individual selection/editing, YouTube thumbnail import, Google Fonts options, CSV/HTML import/export persistence, WebP export, and QCDS evidence are updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is storage quota behavior, broader real-user font files, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
